meaning:
ὠδίνω
[in LXX chiefly for חוּל, also for חָבַל pi., etc. ;]
to have birthpangs, to travail: Gal.4:27 (LXX), Rev.12:2; metaphorically, Gal.4:19 (cf. συν-ωδίνω).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—
She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.
